images.author: Will Burrard-Lucas
images.why: Explicitly identified wild black rhino in Tsavo West, Kenya. Dramatic star-filled sky; genuine camera-trap photograph using flash. Native dimensions and watermark status unverified.

images.author: Rosa Gamboias

images.author: Johan Georget
images.why: Source explicitly identifies a wild black rhinoceros at an Etosha waterhole at sunset and supplies camera settings. Strong sunset setting; dimensions and watermark status unverified.

images.author: Tony Yeomans
images.why: Photographer identifies a black rhino encountered near a waterhole in Etosha. Documented wild encounter; 1024px fallback, with full-body crop and watermark status unverified.

images.author: Charlie Summers
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies Diceros bicornis charging across Etosha and kicking up dust. Dynamic action option; 1024px fallback. Crop and watermark status unverified.

images.author: Timon Cornelissen
images.why: Source identifies black rhinoceros/Diceros bicornis in South Africa. Listed at 3456×4608, useful for portrait cropping. Close-up fallback rather than confirmed full body; visual verification unavailable.

images.author: Bernd Dittrich
images.why: Caption and species tags identify a black rhinoceros in natural habitat at Siwela, KwaZulu-Natal. Freely licensed South African option; close-up, with dimensions and visual checks unverified.

images.author: Patrizia Cocca / GEF
images.why: GEF caption explicitly identifies a wild black rhino in Etosha. Noncommercial licence; linked 1024px fallback. Full-body framing and watermark status unverified.

images.author: Ajeesh VS
images.why: Photo caption explicitly identifies Indian Gaur, Bos gaurus. Forest-clearing composition with a substantial dark animal; supplied 1920-size rendition is below preference. Watermark status unverified.

images.author: Petra Ryan
images.why: Caption identifies wild gaur grazing in India; source lists 6720×4480 and Canon EOS 5D Mark IV capture. High-resolution option, but full-body framing, sex and watermark status unverified.

images.author: Syed Ahmad
images.why: Gaur article credits this forest photograph to Syed Ahmad/Unsplash. Muscular animal with pale stockings and prominent shoulder ridge; original dimensions, precise location and watermark status unverified.

images.author: Peter Connolly
images.why: Photographer identifies gaur in Bandipur National Park, Karnataka. Documented Indian wild-habitat candidate; 1024px fallback. Sex, full-body framing and watermark status unverified.

images.author: Sundaresh Ramanathan
images.why: Caption explicitly confirms Bos gaurus at Bandipur National Park. Species and Indian location established; 1024px fallback. Noncommercial/no-derivatives licence; framing and watermark status unverified.

images.author: akhil
images.why: Source identifies gaur/Bos gaurus at Ooty, India, and lists 6000×4000 with Nikon D3500 capture. Lush setting and ample resolution; close-up fallback with sex and full-body visibility unverified.

images.author: Prema Ganapathy
images.why: Caption explicitly confirms Bos gaurus in the Nilgiris. Free-ranging animal in a garden/tea-estate context, a habitat compromise. Dimensions, full-body framing and watermark status unverified.

images.author: Steven Falk
images.why: Title explicitly identifies a resting gaur bull in the Western Ghats, Goa. Confirmed male fallback, but resting pose limits leg visibility; 1024px rendition and unverified watermark status.
